narr: Abnormal late-May moisture and weak instability fueled scattered thunderstorms over the Mojave Desert. Flash flooding and isolated severe weather occurred.
ev: Cima Road was closed at Interstate 15 due to flooding and erosion on both sides of the freeway. At least one vehicle was stuck with water up to the bottom of the doors.
Flash flooding stranded multiple vehicles at and near Artist's Palette.
Highway 178 was closed east of Highway 127 due to flooding.
Highway 178 was closed at the junction of Highway 127 due to flooding.
Flooding northwest of Twentynine Palms washed away multiple vehicles and caused at least one sinkhole in a road.
Highway 190 was flooded with water and debris and partially washed out. One vehicle was stuck.
Flooding and a mudslide affected the East Main Street off ramp of Interstate 15 South.
